architecture: two BusDevices sharing one state and one VirtualClockHandle: Pit8254 (binding 0x40..0x43, 4 ports) and PitPortB (binding 0x61, 1 port); counters are computed from the clock at access time; no IRQ lines, no events; not wired into the firmware board

formula.tick: T(t) = floor(t_ns * 1193182 / 1e9), one u128 division of absolute time
formula.elapsed: e = T(now) - T(t_write) (free-running tick grid, load aligned to it)
formula.mode0: count = (N - e) mod 65536; OUT low until e >= N, then high
formula.mode2: p = e mod N; count = N - p; OUT low only when p = N - 1; N = 1 refused; new count written while running applies at the next period boundary

examples.three_steps_333333ns: 999999 ns -> 1193 ticks (per-step floor sum would be 1191)

control_word.accepted: channels 0 and 2, access LSB/MSB/LSB+MSB/latch, modes 0 and 2, binary
control_word.refused_unsupported_configuration: BCD, modes 1/3/4/5/6/7, channel 1 (all accesses and latch), read-back (0xC0..0xFF); snapshot unchanged

port_b.bit0_gate2: stored (does not affect counting in this slice)
port_b.bit4_refresh: not stored; (T(now) / 18) & 1, toggles every 18 ticks = 15.085 us (output of refresh channel 1 mode 2 count 18); writes ignored
port_b.bit5_out2: current OUT of channel 2; writes ignored

reset: PitSnapshot::default(): no mode, no count, OUT low, gate2 = 0, speaker = 0

injections.change: pit_ticks rounds up (div_ceil) instead of floor
port 0x61 bit 5 reports OUT of channel 0 instead of channel 2
mode 2 low tick shifted to p = N - 2

not_implemented: board wiring, manifest, handoff, MADT, FADT, firmware
guest calibration and time advance on PIO polling (S4-29d, ISSUE-067)
